{{Quote|By the way, why Operation Caranak?''"<br />"''A caranak is an aquatic fowl native to Endor. It is notoriously difficult to domesticate.''"<br />"''&hellip;a wild goose?''"<br />"''Just so.|[[Tahiri Veila]] and [[Jagged Fel]], after sending [[Javis Tyrr]] on a fruitless search at the [[Indigo Tower]]|<ref name="Omen" />}}
'''Caranaks''' were aquatic fowls native to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. They were notoriously difficult to domesticate.<ref name="Omen" /> [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] described the group that he was leading into [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] blackhole cluster as "caranaks in a row," with his ''[[Jade Shadow]]'' [[Horizon-class star yacht|yacht]] at the head of nearly a dozen [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith Tribe]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]], flying under the protection of the ''[[Rockhound]]'' [[Colossus I Beta Series asteroid tug|asteroid tug]].<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>
